description: This file defines a React context provider for managing application state related to recipes, meal plans, and grocery items, including localStorage persistence and custom hooks.

methods.name: safeRead
methods.description: Safely reads and parses JSON data from localStorage, returning a fallback if reading or parsing fails.

methods.name: safeWrite
methods.description: Safely writes JSON data to localStorage, ignoring quota errors.

methods.name: AppProvider
methods.description: React component that provides application state and actions via context, managing favorites, meal plans, and grocery items with persistence.

methods.name: useApp
methods.description: Custom hook to access the app context, throwing an error if used outside of AppProvider.
